g.text: Everybody thinks I'm in charge. Nope. I'm just the one they listen to. She's the real heart of the team.
We'd all be long dead without her. Including me. Shit, mostly me.
How long have you known each other?
Way back. We served together in the ICR. She's my best mate. Couldn't do any of this nonsense without her.
I guess this is just me asking, in a round about way... if you're single.
Some things aren't your business, you know.
Me? I thought this was about Aoi.
International Crisis Response. The "peace keeping" unit that got us into this shithole mess.
She was just a decoy, I'm really more interested in you.
I figured if I came out and asked you if *you* were single, you'd march over here and punch me.
Uh oh looks like I need to do a forced software update might loose conne -- [End.]
You'll have to take that up with her.
Never pictured you for a flirt.
We've been friends for a long time. Closer for longer than that.
Be sure not to be wearing a whole lot of metal near any important bits when you do.
Does the flirting bother you? I'll stop if it does.
I haven't had a lot of practice, so I'm pretty bad at it, I know.
You don't have to tell me if you don't *want* to.
But if you're itching to ask more about our past, I'm going to have to stop you here. It isn't my story to tell.
Oh good, I'm a target dummy.
Like you wouldn't be able to figure it out, given enough time. We all live in the same bloody mall.
You'll have to ask her about it. But I'll warn you.
If it really bothered me, you'd know. Trust me.
But if you've got to make an arse out of yourself, do it here. No need to make a fool of yourself in front of the others.
Great! I mean, oh, what a shame.
Just don't be wearing a whole lot of metal near any important body parts when you do.
Hah. Just. Let me ask. On the stubborn scale of 1 to 10, how screwed am I?
I'm going to run you down like a kubrodon hunting a pobber on the Venusian plains.
It's not serious. You're just too much fun to tease.
If I had any clue what literally any of that meant, I might know how to react.
Get in the queue with everybody else.
So I guess I'll take it as a compliment and move on.
